changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO CLIENT_SCOPE_ATTRIBUTES (SCOPE_ID, NAME, VALUE) SELECT SCOPE_ID, 'include.in.openid.provider.metadata', CASE WHEN VALUE = 'true' THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END FROM CLIENT_SCOPE_ATTRIBUTES AS CSA WHERE NAME = 'hide.from.openID.provider.metadata' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLIENT_SCOPE_ATTRIBUTES WHERE NAME = 'include.in.openid.provider.metadata' AND SCOPE_ID = CSA.SCOPE_ID );
DELETE FROM CLIENT_SCOPE_ATTRIBUTES WHERE NAME = 'hide.from.openID.provider.metadata';
